description: This Java class LogWrapper implements the LogNode interface to provide a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, allowing logs to be forwarded through a linked chain of LogNodes. It manages log message formatting and propagation within a logging framework.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode to wrap Android's native logging and support chaining of log handlers.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list, enabling chaining of log handlers.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Performs the actual logging by calling Android's Log.println and forwards the log message to the next node if present.
